additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387298-DC/Si-D/TR-[Multi] Downgrade to v4.0.11 CRM:00797001379
additional_info.body:
Good evening Emre,
I am writing you regarding ticket
ID0387298,
this is the second ticket regarding the downgrade of chargers from v5.0.21 to v4.0.11.
Attached you can find a list with the status update of the chargers and the dates when they have been downgraded. Let me summarize here the main remarks, some of them I already communicated to you today via Teams:
Charger
wzcbA7
has firmware v4.0.11 already rolled out, but it is always charging. Please activate the update at your convenience.
Charger
AZLZ7H
did not come back online on SCB after the downgrade. An onsite visit is necessary.
Charger
ywdc0A
is downgraded but has the emergency stop button pressed (just FYI)
Charger
UhGCB8
is offline on SCB since 27.10.
Chargers
nqYmbY, vexyLX, o72nyj, rZ4TIt, u0Lf6z
cannot be downgraded remotely. For all these #5 chargers, the SSH connection keeps getting cut, or the data signal is low, hence the upload speed is very low and it takes ages to send the firmware via OTA. I suggest for these chargers, in case they are severely affected by errorcode:7, to plan an onsite visit and downgrade them manually. Otherwise, I suggest to leave these chargers on v5.0.21 and wait for the release of v5.0.22.
Chargers
cZRTl4
and
XwFc5G
cannot be reached remotely via SSH, and also the reboot command is not sent via SCB. Therefore, I believe it is necessary to go onsite and reboot manually the chargers.
Please let me know if you need further guidance and support. Since an onsite visit is necessary from your side, I will proceed to move this ticket from the
eMobility HQ DC Charger Queue (Level 3)
to the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue (Level 2).
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue (Level 2).
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
eMobility Service Delivery
Expert Services
SI E CS SD ES
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
